newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Kleinwort initiates De Boer as "Buy".
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort initiates De Boer as "Buy".

text.p: Dresdner Kleinwort Benson said it had initiated research coverage of Dutch supermarkets group De Boer Unigro with a "Buy" recommendation.
"The merger of De Boer and unlisted Unigro has created a powerful No. 2 food group in the Netherlands," analysts Albert Breekveldt and Marc van't Sant said in a research note.

"Strong expansion in Spain, restructuring benefits and cost reduction and strengthening of the commercial power of De Boer Unigro's supermarket formulae should result in sustainable double digit earnings growth," they said.

Breekveldt and Van't Sant said that on the basis of 1998 P/E ratios, De Boer Unigro shares currently traded at a 36 percent disount to Ahold and a discount of eight percent to the Dutch market as a whole.
They said the discount versus Ahold was excessive and predicted that the discount to the Dutch market would disappear. They set a one-year price target for the shares of 190 guilders.
